verses.text: Ay jun winh fariseo skuch Nicodemo, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yetyajalil t'a Judea.

Ix k'och winh t'a Jesús t'ak'walil, ix yalan winh t'ay icha tik: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, kojtak to ha Dios chekjinak ach kot onh a k'ayb'ej, yujto ay juntzanh satub'tak tza ch'oxo'. Malaj junok mach syal sk'ulan juntzanh chi', tato manh ayok och Dios yet'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Wal yel swal t'ayach, a mach max aljixi t'a schaelal, manh ol yal-laj yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'an winhaj Nicodemo chi': --Ha junok icham animaxo, ¿tasto ol yutok yaljixi t'a schaelal? ¿Tom tzato yal yoch t'a yol sk'ol snun yik tz'aljixi? xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi Jesús chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Wal yel swal t'ayach, a mach max alji t'a ha ha' yet' pax yuj Yespíritu Dios, manh ol yal-laj yoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios.
Ha heb' tz'alji t'a snun, animanhej heb'. Palta haxo heb' tz'alji pax yuj Yespíritu Dios, espíritu ton heb'.
Manh ak' sat a k'o'ol yuj tas swal tik, yowalil tzex aljixi t'a schaelal.
Ha ik' yalxonhej b'aj sb'ati. Skab' sk'anhi, palta malaj mach ojtannak b'aj skoti yet' b'aj sk'ochi. Icha jun ik' chi', icha chi' yaj heb' tz'alji yuj Yespíritu Dios, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'anxi winh: --¿Tas syalelk'och jun tik? xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jesús: --¿Tom max nachajel juntzanh swal tik u'uj? Ina te k'ayb'um ach t'a skal heb' ketisraelal.
Wal yel swal t'ayach, a tas kojtak, a skala'. Ha tas skila', a skala'. Palta max he cha eyab' tas swal t'ayex.
Tato max he cha eyab' tas swal t'ayex yuj tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ¿tom hato tas ay t'a satcha'anh ol he cha eyab'i?
Malaj junok mach ix xit'k'e t'a satcha'anh. Palta a in tik, hata' kotnak in, yujto Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, aj satcha'anh in.
Icha yutejnak winhaj Moisés st'unhb'ank'e jun k'e'en yechel chan t'a takinh lu'um, icha chi' ol in ajk'e t'unhan.
Icha chi' ol in ajok, yik wach' a jantaknhej heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol satel heb', palta to ol scha sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.

Yujto te xajan heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj Dios, yuj chi' wach'chom a innhej Yuninal in, palta in yak'koti yik wach' a heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol satel-laj heb', palta ay sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha in tik, Yuninal in ton Dios. Manh yujok wak'an sya'elal heb' anima in ak'jikot t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta yuj ul in kolankanel heb'.

Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, manh ol b'atkan heb' t'a sya'elal. Haxo heb' max in ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol jun, ayxokot sya'elal heb' t'a yib'anh, yujto a innhej Yuninal in Dios, palta max in yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Ha in tik in emul t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik swak' sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima. Palta ay pax heb' malaj snib'ej t'a jun sakil k'inal tik. Yuj chi', ol kannhej sya'elal heb' t'a yib'anh. Anhej wal yik k'ik' k'inal snib'ej heb', yujto anhej chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Jantaknhej heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj tz'och jun sakil k'inal tik t'a heb'. Malaj snib'ej heb' scha'ani, yujto xiw heb' scheklajelta juntzanh chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta a heb' sk'anab'ajan jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel, scha jun sakil k'inal tik heb', yik wach' scheklajeli to ayoch Dios yet' heb' t'a tas sk'ulej, xchi Jesús t'a winhaj Nicodemo chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús yet' heb' sk'ayb'um t'a yol yik Judea. Hata' ix ek' jaye' k'ual yet' heb'. Ix yak'an bautizar heb' anima ta'.
Hanhejtona' ix yak'pax bautizar heb' anima winhaj Juan t'a jun lugar skuch Enón, t'a slak'anil Salim, yujto manh jantakok ha ha' ta'. Ix laj k'och heb' anima, ix yak'an bautizar sb'a heb' t'a winh.
Ayik manto ak'jioch winhaj Juan chi' t'a preso, ix sk'ulan juntzanh chi' winh.
Ay jaywanh heb' sk'ayb'um winhaj Juan chi' ix stelaj sb'a yet' jun winh aj Judea yuj tas syutej sb'o'an sb'a heb' anima icha yalan ley.

Yuj chi', xit' yalan heb' t'a winhaj Juan chi': --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, a jun ek'nak het'ok t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, jun alnakkan t'ayonh, a jun chi' wan yak'an bautizar heb' anima tiknaik. Ix laj och heb' sk'ayb'umok, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh t'a heb': --Malaj junok mach syal skomon och yopisio tato manhok Dios tz'ak'an t'ay.
Ha ex tik, eyab'nak walani to manh in Cristooc. Ha in ton tik b'ab'laj chekb'il in kot t'a yichanh Cristo chi'.

K'inalok ay junok nupnajel tz'och tiknaik, a winh wan snupnaj chi', a winh tz'ik'an ix ix chi'. Ha jun yamigo winh snupnaj chi', ayik syab'an yawaj winh snupnaj chi', ste tzalaji. Icha chi' in tzalaj tiknaik, yujto wan yoch heb' anima sk'ayb'umok Jesús.
Ha Cristo chi', yowalil ol te k'ib'nhej yopisio chi'. Ha inxo tik, yowalil k'ojank'olal ol satxiem wopisio tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

--Ha jun emnakkot t'a satcha'anh chi', ek'to yopisio t'a smasanil anima. Ha onhxo ayonh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, anima onnhej ko masanil. Anhej wal yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik skala'. Palta haxo jun emnakkot t'a satcha'anh chi', ek'to yopisio t'ayonh ko masanil.
Ha tas yab'nak yet' tas yilnak, a syala', palta malaj mach scha'an yab' t'ay.
Tato ay heb' scha'an yab' t'ay, sch'oxel heb' to yel syal Dios.
Yujto a jun chi', ha Dios ix chekankoti. Yuj chi' a slolonel Dios syala'. Tz'akan yajoch Yespíritu Dios t'ay.
Ha Yuninal ko Mam Dios, te xajan yuj. Yuj chi', a Smam chi' ix ak'anoch masanil tastak t'a yol sk'ab'.

Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Yuninal Dios t'a sk'o'ol, ayxo sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej. Haxo heb' malaj snib'ej yak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol jun, manh ol schalaj sk'inal heb' t'a junelnhej, palta aykot yowal sk'ol Dios t'a yib'anh heb'.
